content.value: A three stage switching structures supports 128 inlets and 128 outlets. It is proposed (08) to use 16 first stage and third stage matrices.
i) What is the number of switching elements in the switch if it is non-blocking?

ii) At peak periods, the occupancy rate of an inlet is 10%. If the number of switching elements required for non-blocking operation is reduced by a factor of 3, what is the blocking probability of the switch?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
